gop.method: Per word: forced-align the best cmudict canonical pronunciation to the word's phone-CTC frames using a monotone HMM (each phone >=1 frame); GOP_frame = mean_t[log P(canonical phone at t) - max_phone log P(phone at t)]. Variants: mean of per-phone GOPs (phone_mean) and worst-phone GOP (phone_min). A word is flagged when GOP <= threshold; sweep every achievable threshold. Precision = flagged words containing >=1 comparable annotated substitution / all flagged words. Coverage = comparable substitution labels in flagged words / all comparable substitution labels. Word recall = positive words flagged / all positive scored words.

verdict.interpretation: GOP-style scoring with the local CROTTC phone-CTC posteriors does not reach the project's precision >= 0.85 assertion bar at non-trivial coverage. Even in the gold-transcript upper-bound mode the best precision at >=10% substitution-error coverage is ~0.66 (phone-min variant), and precision at >=30% coverage is <= 0.60. An a-priori filler-word exclusion lifts the gold-mode bound to ~0.73 at 10% coverage and ~0.69 at 30-50% coverage, still well short of 0.85. Precision >= 0.85 is attainable only by retaining a handful of true positives (at most 3 words, <=1.2% error coverage). This is consistent with, and no better than, the project's ~0.70 reranker oracle representation bound.

caveats: GOP-style with local CROTTC phone-CTC posteriors, NOT native-ASR GOP (Witt & Young 2000).
Word-level assertion, not phone-level: a flagged word covers every phone error in it.

Primary ground truth = comparable substitutions (kind 's', both EXPECTED and OBSERVED plain uppercase, different); additions/deletions are held out of the precision numerator, matching the project's scorer.
ASR mode uses Whisper word spans/tokens and can mis-transcribe; gold mode uses the annotated transcript and segmentation (upper-bound condition).
The held-out speakers are the CROTTC test split, but the audio is spontaneous Suitcase narrative, so domain shift affects the posteriors.
